a11y.apg: Layout primitive, no role and no keyboard: it is a <div> that lays its children in a wrapping row. Semantics belong to what you put in it.

props.name: children
props.description: Horizontal flow that wraps: centred on the cross axis, --space-3 between items. It is the row of chips, buttons or tags — the one layout that must never cause sideways scrolling, which is why wrapping is not optional.

props.name: gap
props.description: Three steps and no others (ADR-0051): tight is --space-2, normal is --space-3, loose is --space-6. The old rule still holds against ANY spacing; these two extra steps exist for the two measured cases — a note under its value, and a grid of filters.

props.name: align
props.description: The cross axis (vertical). Same names as the native Cluster.

props.name: justify
props.description: The main axis. `between` spreads the free space: a name on the left, a button on the right.

props.name: wrap
props.description: The row wraps by default. `false` keeps everything on one line.

props.name: className
props.description: For justification or width. Every other div attribute passes through.
